definitions.explanation: To have something as a part.
To keep something in one's mouth.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}を{口|くち}に{含|ふく}む。
examples.english: To hold water in one's mouth.

notes:
{含|ふく}む is a godan verb with two main meanings: to contain/include, and to hold in mouth.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: ビタミンを{含|ふく}む

TWO MAIN MEANINGS:
1. To contain/include: {税|ぜい}を{含|ふく}む (including tax)
2. To hold in mouth: {水|みず}を{口|くち}に{含|ふく}む

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～を{含|ふく}む: to contain/include ~
- ～を{含|ふく}めて: including ~
- ～が{含|ふく}まれる: ~ is included (passive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税込|ぜいこ}み: tax included (abbreviation)
- {送料|そうりょう}を{含|ふく}む: including shipping
- {意味|いみ}を{含|ふく}む: to imply meaning

RELATED WORDS:
- {含|ふく}める: to include (causative)
- {含有|がんゆう}: containing (formal)
